title: Points of Judgement on Settling a Northbeam Credit Account
content:
Three terms of each product in the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range decide how a settlement is taken: the ways the account may be settled, which balance a payment is applied to first, and whether the least payment may be collected automatically.

| Product | Ways the account may be settled | Which balance a payment is applied to first | Automatic collection of the least payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | bank transfer, card on file or cash in store | the highest rate balance first, then promotional plans nearest their end | available |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | bank transfer, card on file or cash in store | the highest rate balance first, then promotional plans nearest their end | available |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | bank transfer, card on file or cash in store | the highest rate balance first, then promotional plans nearest their end | available |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | bank transfer or card on file | the promotional plan nearest its end first | available |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | bank transfer or cheque | the oldest invoice first | not available |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | bank transfer or cheque | the oldest invoice first | not available |

## Questions these terms answer

**On an account carrying both a revolving balance and two promotional plans, which does a payment reach first on the three cards that state the highest rate basis?** The highest rate balance first, and then the promotional plans in the order of how near they stand to their end, the nearest first.

**And on the Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account?** The promotional plan nearest its end first; that product's basis names no other balance ahead of it.

**On the two business products?** The oldest invoice first, so a payment works forward through the invoices in the order they were raised.

**Which products take cash in store?** The Northbeam Store Card, the Northbeam Store Card Plus and the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card. The Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account takes bank transfer or card on file; the two business products take bank transfer or cheque, and are the only two in the range that take a cheque.

**Which products offer automatic collection of the least payment?** The four consumer products. It is not available on the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account or the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit.
